conviction_note: No unpriced, decisive company number exists: the bar is unsourced (two aggregators, $3.7M and ~$4.0M, no named analyst), management only guided 'H2 revenue above H1' ($6.64M), and every company-level fact I found (deferred revenue down, cost cuts, CEO buying, a near-cash market cap) has been public since July/August; findings roughly offset (impact_sum -0.1) while the name's 6-of-7 down reaction history and a tough $5.1M year-ago comp tilt p_up slightly under 50 at an abs move of 9% (raised from the 5.95% median for sub-$1 price, ~$30k/day turnover and zero real coverage), giving -0.54.
bar: Unsourced in the strict sense, so every size is capped small. Aggregator Q3 2026 revenue estimates disagree: OpenCapital $3.7M / EPS -$0.10 and StockAlarm ~$4.0M (single estimate), both seen only as search snippets (https://www.opencapital.sh/stocks/awre/earnings/q2-2026 returned 403; https://pro.stockalarm.io/quote/AWRE/analysts is login-walled). VCP Scanner (2026-06-28) lists 0 covering analysts. Company guide (Q2 call, 2026-07-29, https://www.webull.com/news/15364343962084352): H2 2026 revenue higher than H1 ($6.641M per 10-Q https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1015739/000119312526328344/awre-20260630.htm), no numeric range; opex lower in H2 on ~$4M annualized cuts. Year-ago Q3 2025 revenue $5.1M incl. a $1.0M perpetual license expansion (https://idtechwire.com/aware-reports-33-year-over-year-revenue-increase-in-q3-2025-results/). My estimate of the print: ~$3.5-3.8M, i.e. about -5% vs a ~$3.85M midpoint of the two aggregator bars.
positioning_check: Short interest ~70,000 shares at the 2026-07-15 FINRA settlement, ~1.9 days to cover per CurvedTrading (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/awre/short-interest/), ~0.3% of 21.8M shares outstanding; Fintel shows 70,024 shares / 0.94 days (https://fintel.io/ss/us/awre). No crowded short. No usable option chain (12 contracts of total open interest, no two-sided ATM quote), so no skew statement exists. Tape: spot $0.8964 at the seal, -19.96% over 20 sessions, 6.7% above the 52-week low and -64.6% from the high; first close below $1.00 on 2026-10-13 and 12 consecutive sub-$1 closes through 2026-10-28 (Yahoo chart https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/AWRE?range=6mo&interval=1d); intraday +6.3% on 2026-10-28 into the print. 20-day average volume 30,845 shares (~$28k/day), so the print trades through a very thin book.

findings.finding: Q3 2025, the year-ago comp, was $5.1M of revenue including a non-recurring $1.0M perpetual license expansion and $0.6M of new term licenses; against Q1 2026 $3.39M and Q2 2026 $3.25M and an aggregator bar of $3.7-4.0M, Q3 2026 will almost certainly print a headline year-over-year revenue decline of roughly 20-30%, the third consecutive decline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 printed revenue -16.5% YoY ($3.25M vs $3.9M) and the stock rose +3.6% (baseline, 2026-07-29); Q1 2026 printed a decline and fell -20.55% (2026-04-29); Q3 2025 printed +33% YoY and still fell -5.95% (2025-10-29). The YoY headline has not determined the sign.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the year-ago perpetual deal was disclosed a year ago and the H1 run-rate is public. What would be visible if fully priced is exactly what we see (stock at a 52-week low, -20% in October); the residual is that an automated headline 'revenue down ~25%' hits a $28k/day tape after hours.
findings.independence: Q1/Q2 2026 run-rate from the 10-Q, a different document: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1015739/000119312526328344/awre-20260630.htm

findings.finding: Deferred revenue fell from $4.85M current + $0.26M long-term at 2025-12-31 to $3.46M + $0.18M at 2026-06-30 (-29%), and maintenance revenue fell to $2.0M in Q2 from $2.15M; less contracted revenue is sitting on the balance sheet to recognise in H2, so the 'H2 above H1' guide depends on new bookings and renewal timing rather than backlog.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No release has called out deferred revenue as the driver of a reaction; the -20.55% after Q1 2026 came with a revenue decline and widening loss (baseline).
findings.why_not_priced: Public since the 10-Q on 2026-07-31, but with no covering analyst nobody models the deferred-revenue walk; management said renewals are seasonally H2-weighted, which partly explains the drawdown, so the line is ambiguous. If priced, the aggregator bar would sit near the H1 run-rate (~$3.3M) rather than $3.7-4.0M.
findings.independence: Q2 call: management attributed H2 strength to 'seasonality and subscription renewal timing' (https://www.webull.com/news/15364343962084352), which cuts the other way; same company, different document.

findings.finding: Cost cuts of about $4M annualized began in Q2 2026 (Q2 opex $6.0M including part of $0.7M one-time severance); management guided H2 opex lower, so Q3 opex near $5.0-5.3M would narrow the adjusted EBITDA loss from Q2's -$2.3M toward roughly -$1.3 to -1.6M even on flat revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 announced the cuts with a worse EBITDA loss and the stock rose +3.6% and drifted to $1.28 over the following week (Yahoo bars); no prior quarter isolated opex.
findings.why_not_priced: Inside what the company already guided to, so mostly priced; the residual is that the loss line is the one line a near-cash microcap trades on for runway, and no estimate source publishes an opex number.
findings.independence: 10-Q opex and severance detail: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1015739/000119312526328344/awre-20260630.htm (same company, different document).

findings.finding: Federal FY2026 closed on 2026-09-30 without a funding lapse (a stopgap CR through 2026-12-11 was passed in September), whereas the Q2 quarter was hurt by shutdown-related procurement delays and federal activity only 'normalized in May'; September is the federal fiscal-year-end spending month, so Aware's government license line had its first clean year-end quarter since 2024.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (federal lumpiness, $1.0M perpetual) printed +33% revenue and fell -5.95%; government timing has not reliably produced a positive reaction on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: A macro-to-company transmission the company has not confirmed; if the market expected a federal flush the stock would not have fallen 20% in October to a new low. No federal prime award to Aware dated in calendar 2026 appears in the USAspending-based profile (latest DOJ $497K on 2025-12-03), but most Aware federal revenue flows through integrators, so the absence is weak.
findings.independence: Proxy only. Q2 call that federal activity normalized in May (https://www.webull.com/news/15364343962084352); USAspending-derived award list https://govconinabox.com/explore/contractors/profile/aware-inc-gzxsnu shows no 2026 prime award.

findings.finding: CEO Ajay Amlani made open-market purchases after both 2026 prints (about 69,000 shares across seven Form 4s from 2026-05-01 to 05-26 and about 36,700 shares from 2026-07-31 to 08-12) and director John Stafford bought about 100,000 shares in May; no insider sale since May. The buying stopped on 2026-08-12, while the stock still traded at $1.17-1.28 through mid-September.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The post-Q2 buying coincided with the stock rising from $1.11 to $1.28 in the week after the print (Yahoo bars); the May buying did not stop the post-Q1 slide.
findings.why_not_priced: Public Form 4s, so it is a sentiment signal rather than information; the stop in August while the window was presumably still open slightly weakens it. If the market read it as a floor the stock would not have broken $1.

findings.finding: At the sealed spot of $0.8964 times 21.81M shares the market cap is about $19.6M, against $16.8M of cash and marketable securities and no debt at 2026-06-30; with H1 operating cash use of $5.44M and lower H2 opex, Q3-end cash is probably about $14-15M, so the enterprise value is roughly $5M on a ~$13-14M revenue run-rate and any confirmation of slower burn reads against a cash floor.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 reported cash down $5.5M in six months and the stock rose; there is no case in the baseline of a cash-floor bounce being decisive.
findings.why_not_priced: The cash is public; what is not is the Q3 burn. The October drawdown has no cause in EDGAR (no 8-K since 2026-07-29), which by itself is worth nothing, and continued tax-loss or sub-$1 selling can override a cash floor in a $28k/day stock.
findings.independence: Share count and cash from the same 10-Q; price from Yahoo chart https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/AWRE?range=6mo&interval=1d

findings.finding: On 2026-06-09 Aware targeted general availability of the expanded Awareness Platform (orchestration with Mitek and ROC integrations) for Q3 2026; the company's news list shows no release between 2026-07-29 and the 2026-10-14 webcast notice, so no GA, customer or partner launch was announced inside Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Product/platform messaging accompanied the -20.55% Q1 2026 reaction and the +3.6% Q2 reaction alike; no measured history on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: An absence, sized small: if GA had slipped, the call is where it surfaces, and the forward narrative is the only thing management guides on. If the market expected a launch it would have shown up as a September bid; there was none.

outside_window.finding: Nasdaq minimum bid price: first close below $1.00 on 2026-10-13 and 12 consecutive sub-$1 closes through 2026-10-28; a deficiency notice and 8-K Item 3.01 follow 30 consecutive business days below $1, around 2026-11-24, after the exit window. No reverse split was authorized at the 2026-07-15 annual meeting.

The stopgap CR funding the federal government expires 2026-12-11, so Q4 (Aware's seasonally strongest quarter) carries another possible shutdown risk for federal procurement; management may flag it on the call but the event itself is after the window.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with; the findings net roughly to zero against a 20-day run-up of -20% and a 6-of-7 negative reaction history, so the slight negative lean follows the name's own base rate rather than cutting against the tape.

Rule 6/core table (lands inside what the company guided): cost-cut finding +0.5 -> +0.2
Rule 5 (macro-to-company proxy not confirmed by the company): federal fiscal-year-end finding +0.5 -> +0.3
Rule 5 (unexplained microcap drawdown worth 0): near-cash valuation finding +0.4 -> +0.2, kept only for the documented cash number
Public Form 4 buying is a sentiment signal already visible: +0.3 -> +0.2; platform-GA absence -0.3 -> -0.2
Rule 8 (thin coverage) and core table: abs_move_pct raised from 8 to 9; p_up 48 -> 47 reflecting the name's 6-of-7 negative reaction history, so expected_move -0.32 -> -0.54
